content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Solana payment

This is a sovereign commerce stack. It’s a combination of free tools and paid components that give you a fully operational digital product store. It uses Solana for payments because Solana is fast, cheap, and globally accessible. The stack automates everything: payment verification, order storage, product delivery. You don’t need Stripe. You don’t need PayPal. You don’t need Gumroad. You own the entire system after deployment. No platform fees. No KYC. No buyer accounts required. Your customers pay in SOL or USDT. The system verifies the payment on-chain. The product delivers instantly. You keep 99.5% of every sale. At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, you retain $921 more than Gumroad would let you keep. This is financial sovereignty. Built for creators who need it.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The stack uses GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting. Both are free. Both are globally distributed. The backend logic runs on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Both are serverless. Both scale automatically. Order data stores in Supabase or Google Sheets. Both are free to start. Both are easy to query. Product files deliver from Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Both are reliable. Both are cost-effective. Payments process through NOWPayments. It supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. It charges 0.5% per transaction. It fires a webhook the moment payment confirms on-chain. The webhook triggers the delivery script. The customer gets their product instantly. The entire system is stateless. No database dependencies. No server management. You deploy once. It runs forever.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is built for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are unavailable or severely restricted. Nigeria. Ghana. Kenya. Pakistan. Bangladesh. Ethiopia. Venezuela. Zimbabwe. Cameroon. Tanzania. Philippines. If Stripe locked you out, this is for you. If PayPal flagged your account, this is for you. If Gumroad’s fees are cutting into your margins, this is for you. You sell ebooks. Courses. Templates. Fonts. Presets. Beats. Plugins. Software. Digital products. You need a way to collect payment. You need a way to deliver the product. You need to own the entire system. This stack gives you that. It’s not a workaround. It’s infrastructure. Built to last. Built to scale. Built for you.
Solana payments cost under $0.10 per transaction. Stripe and PayPal can’t compete.
The Components That Make It Work Together

GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host your storefront. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic. Supabase or Google Sheets store order data. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 deliver product files. NOWPayments processes crypto payments. Each component is chosen for a reason. GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages are free and globally distributed. Cloudflare Workers and Google Apps Script are serverless and scalable. Supabase and Google Sheets are easy to use and query. Google Drive and Cloudflare R2 are reliable and cost-effective. NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies and charges only 0.5% per transaction. The components integrate seamlessly. The system is stateless. No single point of failure. You deploy. You own. You control.

Integrate NOWPayments for crypto processing. Test end-to-end. Launch. You own the entire system after deployment. No platform fees. No subscriptions. Lifetime access. Infrastructure sovereignty. Not renting. Owning.

1. Choose your hosting: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Both are free. Both are globally distributed. 2. Set up your backend logic: Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Both are serverless. Both scale automatically. 3. Configure your order storage: Supabase or Google Sheets. Both are free to start. Both are easy to query. 4. Upload your product files: Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Both are reliable. Both are cost-effective. 5. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto processing. It supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. It charges 0.5% per transaction. 6. Test your stack end-to-end. Ensure payment verification works. Ensure product delivery works. 7. Deploy. You own the entire system. No platform fees. No subscriptions. Lifetime access.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not a developer?
Yes. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes step-by-step blueprints and templates. You don’t need to write code from scratch. Follow the instructions. Deploy your stack. Own your infrastructure.
What cryptocurrencies does NOWPayments support?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Recommended networks for low fees: BSC, Solana, TRON. Transaction fees under $0.10. No KYC. No buyer accounts required.
How do I handle refunds?
Refunds are handled manually. Since you own the entire system, you can issue refunds directly from your wallet. No platform involvement. No additional fees.
Can I scale this stack as my business grows?

Yes. The stack is built on serverless architecture. It scales automatically. Cloudflare Workers and Google Apps Script handle increased traffic. Supabase and Google Sheets scale with your order volume.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
NOWPayments has a 99.9% uptime guarantee. In the unlikely event of downtime, your storefront remains operational. Payments can be processed manually or through a backup gateway.
